newsitem.title: UK: UK M&A deals totalled 55.9 bln stg in '96 - report.
newsitem.headline: UK M&A deals totalled 55.9 bln stg in '96 - report.

text.p: UK merger and acquisition deals totalled 55.9 billion stg in 1996, falling short of last year's record of 67.7 billion stg, a study released Monday shows.
Acquisitions Monthly magazine said this year's total included 1,689 deals, after 1,694 in 1995.

"1996 was an excellent year for the UK M&A industry. And, even with a general election on the horizon in 1997, we expect the market to remain buoyant whatever the result," editor Philip Healey said in a statement.

UK firms made a record number of acquisitions in the U.S. and Europe in 1996, acquiring 145 U.S. companies for a total of just under $40 billion and buying 244 firms in continental Europe in deals worth 6.5 billion stg.

The magazine said British Telecommunications Plc spent the most money in both regions, with its planned $20 billion merger with MCI Communications Corp and its 1.1 billion stg buy of a 25 percent stake in France's Cegetel.
Baring Brothers, part of ING Barings, advised on UK merger and acquisitions worth a total of 11.8 billion stg in 1996, beating other investment banks for the second year running, the magazine said.
